body.summary: K0 closed in DONE-20260927-knowledge-k0-contracts; K1 closed in DONE-20260926-knowledge-k1-identity. K2–K6 implementations and K7a tooling are on main. The token-mode K7a pilot passed on an isolated copy at 6423734 (k7a-token-pilot-20260927.md); cutover, K2–K6 acceptance reconciliation and K8/K9 remain in the parent. SQLite remains current; PostgreSQL is deferred. Read the dated status at the top of implementation-plan.md before its historical sequence. Storage safety assessment and S0–S6 completion plan added on 2026-09-28; RWK-20260928-sqlite-data-safety tracks technical prerequisites before real-project cutover. Storage safety plan refreshed on 2026-10-01 against 6a9df6e: schema 27, pre-migration backup and ownership gaps rechecked; proposed recovery targets, backup retention/off-host protection, bounded PR sequence, restore recovery and production upgrade procedure added. Operational parameters remain proposed; no implementation or production change was performed. Owner clarified that backups are optional and configured only through CLI parameters, with GUI limited to browsing and optional operator-authorized on-demand creation/restore. The current plan supersedes mandatory backup assumptions: automatic backups default off, migration gates apply only when enabled, and SaaS tenant administrators cannot manage global backups. A further owner proposal adds independent application user-space schedules managed through GUI/API within CLI policy. Service schedule/retention remain CLI-only; user timing/retention are separate and execution is shared and bounded. SaaS user schedules cover authorized logical exports, never whole-installation SQLite backups. S4u records this additional scope. The plan now defines one feature branch/worktree and PR per slice, sequential main-based delivery and a first-run handoff in storage-safety-worker-01.md. Each worker run ends at a reviewable PR; merge and production rollout are separate. S1a + S2a implemented on feat/sqlite-pre-migration-backup at 7f9f82ce2a9bf24b7d174cbdacd939c1bb952ada and submitted in PR #68 on 2026-10-01. Managed check/build/integration/UI verification passed on that clean revision. The dated slice report records run IDs, fixture origins and limits. The PR remains open; no merge, production rollout or later slice was performed. Review follow-up on 2026-10-01 classified the single WAL startup claim as false positive after isolated SIGKILL tests with present/missing shared-memory index. Four crash cases were added in f1f02a6b42d3eb3539c53055eab96dd63e417df3; managed check passed with 552 Vitest and 7 script tests. The original thread has an evidence reply and is resolved; the report includes the follow-up and separates earlier build/integration/UI results. PR #68 was merged at afe9f20. S1b + S2b was delivered from that main baseline on feat/sqlite-durable-migrations at fced54c4f94111fb0f815ba4a100de2d864372e2 in open PR #69 (2026-10-01). WAL/FULL verification, private owned data paths, atomic initialization/migrations, honest migration-28 provenance and startup integrity/FK/application checks are implemented. Final managed check (585 Vitest + 7 scripts), build, integration (23) and separate ext4 write-cost preset passed; Chromium (134) passed on 9b0fcc3 before fixture-only permission changes. Isolated package smoke at umask 022 passed through the host heavy runner. Dated report and raw evidence record revision attribution, failures corrected and limitations. Overall task remains open; no power-loss test, old installed-artifact upgrade, production change, merge or next slice was performed.
